title: Werkstudent (m/w/d) Strategy & Business Development (AI-Taskforce)
description: Deine Mission Alle reden über AI. Wir entscheiden, wie sie im Unternehmen wirklich eingesetzt wird. Ein 400-Milliarden-Dollar-Markt. Ein profitables Scale-up, das ihn mit AI und einem globalen Freelancer-Netzwerk neu denkt. Und mittendrin ein Team, das nicht primär Code schreibt, sondern entscheidet, was AI im Unternehmen bewirken soll - für mehr als 25.000 Talents in über 70 Ländern, durch Automatisierung und intelligente Prozesse. Wir suchen dich als Werkstudent (m/w/d) Strategy & Business Development (AI-Taskforce) in unserem Headquarter in München -Schwabing für unsere cross-funktionale strategische Taskforce. Du arbeitest an der Schnittstelle von Strategy, Business und AI - als Sparringspartner:in für AI Engineers, Product- und Operations-Expert:innen sowie eine ehemalige BCG-Beraterin. Nicht als zusätzliche:r Engineer im Team, sondern als die Person, die dafür sorgt, dass das Team das Richtige baut. Das ist keine klassische Werkstudentenstelle für Techies. Du strukturierst Probleme, baust Business Cases, bewertest AI-Anwendungen aus Business-Perspektive und übersetzt zwischen dem, was technisch möglich ist, und dem, was strategisch sinnvoll ist. Die Konzepte, an denen du arbeitest, landen nicht in einer Schublade - sie fließen direkt in Entscheidungen unseres Leadership-Teams ein. Was du wirklich machst AI-Strategie statt AI-Code: Du arbeitest an strategischen AI-Initiativen wie unserem Talent Assistant oder AutoQA 2.0 (KI-basierte Voice-File-Analyse) mit - nicht als Entwickler:in, sondern als jemand, der Anforderungen strukturiert, Prioritäten setzt und aus ersten Ideen belastbare Feature-Konzepte macht. Die technische Umsetzung übernehmen unsere AI Engineers; du sorgst dafür, dass sie das Richtige bauen. Aus Ideen werden Entscheidungen: Du analysierst komplexe Fragestellungen, baust Business Cases nach klassischer Case-Logik auf und entwickelst Entscheidungsgrundlagen für unser Leadership-Team. Deine Analysen beeinflussen unmittelbar, welche AI-Initiativen umgesetzt werden. AI braucht Struktur: Große Sprachmodelle sind nur so gut wie die Daten dahinter. Du definierst Kompetenzframeworks und Bewertungslogiken, die unsere AI-Systeme intelligenter machen - die inhaltliche Logik, nicht die technische Implementierung. Eigene Projekte mit echtem Ownership: Du übernimmst eigenständig Themen von der ersten Analyse bis zum ersten Konzept - ein neuer AI-Use-Case, ein Workflow, der heute noch manuell läuft, eine Automatisierung, ein neuer Lösungsansatz. Der Inhalt wechselt, der Anspruch nicht: Du bekommst Verantwortung, nicht nur Aufgaben. Dort arbeiten, wo gerade der größte Hebel liegt: Du unterstützt unser Team dort, wo aktuell die spannendsten strategischen Fragestellungen entstehen. title: Platform & DevOps Engineer (m/w/d)
description: Deine Mission Skalierung braucht ein Fundament, das mitwächst. Über unsere Plattform laufen täglich Interaktionen von mehr als 25.000 Talents in 70+ Ländern, und mit unserem Wachstumsziel von 500 Mio. € Umsatz bis 2030 steigt der Anspruch an unsere Cloud-Platform, Deployment-Prozesse und Kosteneffizienz kontinuierlich. Als Platform & DevOps Engineer (m/w/d) im hybriden Modell an einem unserer Standorte in München, Berlin oder Halle (Saale) verantwortest du unsere Cloud Platform, primär auf Microsoft Azure. Du entscheidest, wie wir Infrastruktur designen, betreiben und optimieren, mit klarem Fokus auf Skalierbarkeit, Zuverlässigkeit und Kosteneffizienz. Gleichzeitig gestaltest du unsere CI/CD-Plattform und Self-Service-Tools weiter, die unseren Engineering-Teams schnelleres und sichereres Deployment ermöglichen. Deine Aufgaben Cloud Platform & Developer Enablement Azure Platform Ownership: Du verantwortest Design, Betrieb und Weiterentwicklung unserer Cloud-Infrastruktur, von Compute und Networking bis Identity und Governance. Infrastructure as Code statt Klick-Administration: Du entwickelst und pflegst IaC mit Terraform, stellst wiederverwendbare Module bereit und automatisierst, was manuell fehleranfällig wäre. CI/CD-Plattform kontinuierlich weiterentwickeln: Du automatisierst Deployments über den gesamten Software-Lifecycle und baust Self-Service-Plattformen, die Dev-Teams eigenständiger machen. Developer Experience mitdenken: Du arbeitest eng mit Engineering und Product zusammen, um Delivery-Prozesse und Plattform-Fähigkeiten laufend zu verbessern. Platform Reliability, Security & Cost Efficiency Platform Reliability im Blick: Du monitorst Performance, Verfügbarkeit und Stabilität und gehst Infrastruktur- und Deployment-Probleme proaktiv an, bevor sie zum Incident werden. Security by Design: Gemeinsam mit unserem CISO-Team integrierst du Security Controls direkt in Plattform und CI/CD-Prozesse, inklusive Azure Security Services, Policies und Benchmarks. Kosteneffizienz als Designprinzip: Du optimierst Infrastruktur und Deployment-Plattformen konsequent auf Skalierbarkeit, Performance und Kosten, von Anfang an statt nachträglich. FinOps in der Praxis: Du baust Cloud-Cost-Monitoring, Budgeting und Forecasting auf und lieferst konkrete Empfehlungen zur laufenden Kostenoptimierung. Dein Skillset Cloud Platform: Hands-on-Erfahrung mit Microsoft Azure in Compute, Networking, Storage, Identity und Governance, plus Verständnis von Cloud-Architektur-Prinzipien auch über Azure hinaus. Automation: Routiniert mit Terraform, Bicep oder ARM, CI/CD-Pipelines mit GitLab CI/CD oder vergleichbaren Tools produktiv aufgebaut, Configuration Management automatisiert statt manuell gepflegt. Container & Scripting: Erfahrung mit Docker und Kubernetes/Nomad oder Azure ACA/ACI, sichere Scripting-Skills in Python, PowerShell oder Bash. Observability & Security: Monitoring, Logging und Alerting im Alltag, angewandtes Verständnis von IAM, RBAC, Zero Trust und Privileged Identity Management, praktische Erfahrung mit GDPR, ISO 27001, SOC 2 oder PCI DSS. FinOps: Cloud-Usage-Analyse, Ressourcenoptimierung und kosteneffiziente Architekturen als Teil deines Designs, nicht als Nachgedanke. Azure-Zertifizierungen, FinOps-Frameworks, Serverless-Architekturen oder Erfahrung mit verteilten oder hybriden Systemen sind ein Plus. Arbeitsweise: Analytisches, lösungsorientiertes Denken, Eigenverantwortung im interdisziplinären Umfeld, klare Kommunikation mit technischen wie nichttechnischen Stakeholdern, fließendes Englisch und eine gesunde Portion Humor. Dein Winning Deal Die Werte: Wir punkten mit einer offenen, authentischen Kultur und einem leistungsstarken sowie humorvollen Team, das sich schon jetzt darauf freut, mit dir mutige Entscheidungen zu treffen und neue Wege zu gehen, die uns zu nachhaltigen Erfolgen führen. Dein Footprint: Eine Position in einer profitablen Company, in der deine Infrastruktur-Entscheidungen direkten Einfluss auf Skalierung und Kosten haben, nicht nur auf dem Papier. Deine Chance: Bei uns hast du vom ersten Tag an die Möglichkeit, Verantwortung zu übernehmen, Innovationen voranzutreiben und gemeinsam mit einem Team aus Expert:innen das Unternehmen und dich weiterzuentwickeln. Deine Benefits: Neben 30 Tagen Urlaub bieten wir dir außerdem einen "Joblunch"-Zuschuss (69 € im Monat), eine "Givve"-Card (wird monatlich mit 50 € aufgeladen) oder alternativ eine bezuschusste "Wellpass" Mitgliedschaft, Rabatte via "Corporate Benefits", die Möglichkeit eines "JobRad"-Leasings, Zuschüsse zur Altersvorsorge (bAV & VL) sowie grandiose Team- und Companyevents. Dein Arbeitsplatz: Bei uns arbeitest du im flexiblen, hybriden Modell aus einem unserer hundefreundlichen und modernen Offices und hast zudem die Möglichkeit auf 2 Wochen im Jahr Workation innerhalb der EU (*gilt nur für Mitarbeiter:innen mit EU-Pass). title: Solutions Architecture Senior Manager, EMEA
description:
About Nebius:

Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. We are building a full-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in-house AI/ML infrastructure.

Built by engineers, for engineers. From large-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI.

Listed on Nasdaq (NBIS) and headquartered in Amsterdam, we have a global footprint with R&D hubs across Europe, the UK, North America and Israel. Our team of 1,500+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R&D.

The role

As we continue to scale our business across EMEA, we are looking for an experienced Solutions Architecture Senior Manager, EMEA to lead our customer-facing Solutions Architecture organization across the region.

This is a leadership role responsible for building, developing and scaling a high-performing Solutions Architecture organization across multiple countries and markets. You will partner closely with EMEA Sales leadership, establish the operating model for the regional team, and ensure our Solutions Architects consistently deliver outstanding technical leadership and business value to customers. The scope of the role reflects where the business is today; as we scale, we expect the organization to specialize and subdivide, and this leader will help shape and staff that evolution.

We are looking for an experienced people leader who can build and empower strong teams while remaining close to customers, technology and our most strategic opportunities.

You’re welcome to work remotely from Europe.

Your responsibilities will include: 

  • Build, lead and coach a high-performing Solutions Architecture team across multiple countries and markets in EMEA
  • Own the Solutions Architecture engagement model for EMEA in close partnership with regional Sales leadership, including how coverage and ownership are divided as the team expands
  • Establish clear priorities, operating mechanisms and performance expectations across the regional Solutions Architecture organization
  • Develop and scale the organization as the business grows, including hiring, coaching and developing senior technical professionals and future leaders
  • Engage directly with CIOs, CTOs, Heads of Infrastructure, Heads of AI/ML, Business leaders and other senior stakeholders across strategic customers and partners
  • Champion the voice of EMEA customers internally and provide guidance for Nebius's Product and Technology roadmap

We expect you to have: 

  • Proven people-management experience, including hiring, coaching and developing senior technical professionals and leaders
  • A strong track record of leading customer-facing technical teams across EMEA, with experience managing teams distributed across multiple countries and markets
  • Demonstrated experience building, scaling and operating regional Solutions Architecture, Sales Engineering, Customer Engineering or similar technical organizations
  • Strong player-coach mentality with the ability to operate effectively at both leadership and execution levels — from organizational strategy and talent development to direct engagement in strategic customer opportunities
  • Deep understanding of the EMEA technology market and the ability to operate effectively across different countries, cultures, customer segments and levels of market maturity
  • Ability to operate effectively across both the technical and business dimensions of complex customer engagements and influence C-level and senior stakeholders
  • Excellent executive communication, presentation and stakeholder-management skills
  • Ability to operate effectively in a fast-growing environment where team structures, coverage boundaries and scope of ownership will continue to evolve

It will be an added bonus if you have: 

  • Strong understanding of cloud-native infrastructure, including compute, storage, networking, security and Kubernetes
  • Leadership experience within a public cloud, hyperscaler or rapidly scaling cloud infrastructure organization
  • Experience with GPU-based infrastructure workloads and accelerated computing
  • Experience designing or supporting machine learning and AI workloads, including training and inference
  • Understanding of distributed AI/ML infrastructure and the compute, networking and storage considerations associated with large-scale GPU workloads
  • Experience with Kubernetes-based AI/ML platforms, MLOps or AI infrastructure
  • Experience helping customers evaluate the economics of large-scale compute or GPU workloads

Benefits & Perks:

  • Competitive compensation
  • Career growth and learning opportunities
  • Flexibility and ownership
  • Collaborative and innovative culture
  • Opportunity to work on impactful AI projects
  • International environment and talented teams

What's it like to work at Nebius:

Fast moving - Bold thinking - Constant growth - Meaningful impact - Trust and real ownership - Opportunity to shape the future of AI

Nebius is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse workplace and to providing equal employment opportunities in all aspects of employment. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy), national origin, ancestry, age, disability, genetic information, marital status, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

title: Senior Director, Program & Change Management
description:
About WPP Media

WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. With exceptional talent, trusted data and intelligence, and world-class partnerships – all united by our pioneering agentic marketing platform, WPP Open – we help clients navigate change, capture opportunity, and deliver transformational growth.

WPP Media is WPP's AI-driven media operating unit, bringing together media, data, and partnerships to deliver creative personalisation at scale. Connected through WPP Open and powered by Open Intelligence, clients see exactly where, how, and why their media investment is working.

For more information, visit wppmedia.com.

About Media Futures Group:

Media Futures Group (MFG) is a bespoke team within WPP that delivers on our commitment to Google for a more strategic, creative and integrated media approach established to drive better business results. 

The MFG team is made up of best in class digital, offline, and integrated media experts who work together to enhance media’s contribution to Google’s business. 2900 – Data Engineer - GCS

Role Summary and Impact

About WPP Media Global Client Solutions

WPP Media's Global client teams are organised within a centralised squad based in London.  A critical part of that is the WPP Media Global 'Strategy and Capabilities' team - a unit of 160 specialists focused on industry leading Strategic Planning, Insights and Innovation, working across WPP's global clients including Nestlé, Coca Cola, Danone, Unilever, AirBnB, Ford, Adidas, IKEA, L'Oreal and more. We operate at the forefront of the industry, collaborating seamlessly across WPP's ecosystem of experts to deliver integrated strategies and drive tangible business outcomes. We believe in the power of media to transform businesses and connect deeply with consumers.

WPP Media is looking for a Data Engineer with interest in machine learning (ML) engineering, as well as the productionisation and optimization of ML models to join our Global Data Strategy & Insights team.  While operating within our team you will be asked to use our proprietary and/or client data along with ML techniques to help answer client questions around audiences like: ‘which audience should I be advertising to?’, ‘how should my strategy be different when approaching this audience?’, ‘how is does my media plan need to change across geographies?’. You will also be assisting our team in developing products to help both our global and local teams with day-to-day media planning. This reaches from hypothesis testing, data experiments, and predictive and prescriptive analysis.

In this role, you will have the opportunity to collaborate with other data scientists and engineers (e.g. in our Analytics team) with experience and expertise in a wide range of methodologies, toolkits and applications to a variety of problems in the media landscape. This reaches from data engineering, setting and defining best practices and scaling ML POCs. You will also be collaborating with strategists, insights specialists and non-technical stakeholders to ensure the data structures align with the client use case and specifications. 

The ideal candidate would be curious, flexible and passionate about using data science/ML as a tool to understand human behaviour, campaign effectiveness and business dynamics. We are a data agnostic team that believe the key to success is not just having access to different types of data (market research, surveys, online behavioural panels, site data, targeted web-scraping) but finding new, innovative ways to connect and analyse the data we have access to, to deliver real, actionable, insight for our clients. 

Key responsibilities for this position include:

  • Using data engineering techniques to clean, process and re-format large volumes of data
  • Implementing coding changes to our existing tools to improve them or adapt them for different use cases
  • Testing functionalities of our various tools and providing feedback on improvements that can be implemented.
  • Assisting our Fusion Data Scientist in preparing different types of data for data fusion (incl. mapping variables, recoding data etc.)
  • Performing checks on survey data and preparing data for trend analysis
  • Develop and maintain a number of our Python packages
  • Ingesting survey data into different tools to be used for insights, planning, modelling and reporting (both WPP Media and WPP Data Tech Solutions )
  • Assisting in the development of new products/tools

Skills and Experience

  • Curiosity, flexibility, problem solving skills, a scientific mindset and an enthusiasm for learning new things are key attributes.
  • Fundamentally interested in people - Interested in the world around you and what makes people behave the way they do and how data and research can get you closer to understanding it.
  • Able to work well as part of a team – you understand that one person can’t do or know everything and so you are willing to explore alternative routes, even if they are outside your comfort zone.
  • Fast learner, with the ability to work across multiple workstreams at once
  • Excited by telling stories from information by weaving different sources together into a convincing whole.
  • Able to think critically and with curiosity about information sources
  • Able to manage multiple stakeholders 

Skills we need:

  • Strong analytical skills and statistical knowledge, as well as interest in applying them to complex problems
  • Competent with Python
  • Comfortable manipulating and reshaping data to suit a particular task or tale
  • Knowledge of Git
  • Able to communicate ideas well, both verbally and written to both technical and non-technical stakeholders
  • Knowledge of cloud computing (desirable)
  • Knowledge of docker (desirable)
  • Exposure to SQL, R, SPSS or other programming languages (desirable)

Our passion for shaping the next era of media is powered by our commitment to Be Extraordinary, investing in our employees to inspire transformational creativity. We also Lead Optimistically, firmly believing in and Championing Growth and Development for every individual. This commitment allows WPP Media employees to leverage the extensive global WPP Media & WPP networks to pursue their passions, build vital professional connections, and learn at the cutting edge of marketing and advertising. 

We Create an Open environment built on trust and respect, where everyone feels they belong and has opportunities to progress. This inclusive culture is fostered through a variety of employee resource groups and frequent in-office events showcasing team wins, sharing thought leadership, and celebrating holidays and milestone events. Our comprehensive benefits package reflects this commitment, including competitive medical, group retirement plans, vision, and dental insurance, significant paid time off, preferential partner discounts, and employee mental health awareness days. 

WPP Media is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to characteristics. We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection in this open and supportive environment. That's why we’ve adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around four days a week. description:
At Hudl, we build great teams. We hire the best of the best to ensure you’re working with people you can constantly learn from. That’s why we help teams from all over the world see their game differently. Our products make it easier for coaches and athletes at any level to capture video, analyze data, share highlights and more.

Ready to join us?

 

Your Role

We're looking for a Product Designer to help shape the shared experiences and systems that connect Hudl's products.

Hudl is bringing together products used across sports, teams and organizations into a more connected platform. That creates design problems that don't always fit neatly within a single feature or product: how information is structured, how common workflows behave across products, how video and data work together, and how emerging technologies like AI change the way people interact with Hudl.

You'll work within Core UX, the team responsible for the design foundations that help Hudl's products feel clear, consistent and connected. Our work includes shared patterns and experiences, information architecture, video and data, and the systems that help product teams build at scale.

In this role, you'll:

  • Solve connected problems. You'll work on experiences that cross features, products and workflows, considering how individual design decisions fit into the broader Hudl platform.
  • Make complexity easier to understand. You'll turn complicated workflows, information and technical constraints into experiences that feel clear and intuitive.
  • Work across teams. You'll partner with product, engineering and other designers to understand problems, explore solutions and help create experiences that can work at scale.
  • Design from evidence. You'll learn directly from customers, use research and product data to inform your work, and test and iterate on ideas as you go.
  • Own your work through delivery. You'll independently run scoped design projects, working from early exploration through implementation and measuring how well the solution works once it's shipped.

For this role, we're currently considering candidates who are within commuting distance of our offices in London, but we're also open to remote candidates in the U.K.

Must-Haves

  • Strong product design craft. You can turn complex requirements into clear, intuitive experiences through strong interaction and visual design. You know how to choose the right methods and level of fidelity for the problem, moving between exploration, prototyping and delivery.
  • Systems thinking. You're comfortable working through ambiguity, naturally look for connections, and consider how a solution might affect other workflows, users or parts of a product.
  • Collaborative communication. You can explain your thinking, seek out feedback and work through different perspectives with product, engineering and design partners.
  • Customer and evidence focus. You're comfortable talking with customers and using research, product data and other evidence to make and evaluate design decisions.
  • AI fluency. You actively use AI tools in your design process and are curious about how AI changes the products we design. You're comfortable experimenting with emerging interaction patterns and thinking critically about where AI can improve an experience.
  • A strong portfolio. You can show how you've worked through product problems, including your reasoning, collaboration and iteration rather than only the final solution.

Nice-to-Haves

  • Experience with complex or connected products. You’ve designed experiences that span multiple workflows, surfaces or parts of a larger product, and understand how individual design decisions contribute to a cohesive experience.
  • Experience with data-rich or technical products. You’ve designed products involving complex data, analytics, video or other technically challenging workflows.
  • Experience with design systems or information architecture. You’ve worked with shared patterns, design systems, information architecture or other foundations that help experiences scale across a product.
  • AI product design experience. You’ve designed conversational, agentic or other AI-powered experiences and have explored emerging interaction patterns beyond traditional interfaces.

Our Role

  • Champion work-life harmony. We’ll give you the flexibility you need in your work life (e.g., flexible vacation time, company-wide holidays and timeout (meeting-free) days, remote work options and more) so you can enjoy your personal life too.

  • Encourage career growth. We’re lifelong learners who encourage professional development. We’ll give you tons of resources and opportunities to keep growing.
  • Provide an environment to help you succeed. We've invested in our offices, designing incredible spaces with our employees in mind. But whether you’re at the office or working remotely, we’ll provide you the tech stack and hardware to do your best work.

We make compensation decisions based on an individual's experience, skills and education in line with our internal pay equity practices.

description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

ABOUT THE TEAM

The Maneuver Dominance team is building Thunder - an autonomous attack rotorcraft built to fight alongside crewed combat aviation to deliver overwhelming mass effects deep beyond the front lines. The team in London builds the Mission System and the Autonomy that makes aircraft like Thunder work.

A mission system is only a system if the parts agree. Thunder's payloads and subsystems are being developed in parallel, across teams and across companies, onto an air vehicle that is moving underneath them. The decomposition, the interfaces, and the evidence that it all works together are what hold that together. That is the problem you would own.

ABOUT THE JOB

We are looking for a Senior Systems Engineer to join us in London and lead capability development on Thunder. You will bring pragmatic systems engineering thinking to complement and enhance the overall mission system capability, ensuring end-user needs are met in challenging operational environments. You will be part of a lean, high-ownership culture where you directly shape the product and operate at a velocity to fly new designs within months, not years.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

  • Execute a right-sized, Agile Systems Engineering approach as per the Systems Engineering Management Plan (SEMP) for development of the Thunder Mission System and Payloads at the speed of relevance
  • Support design teams in the evolution and progress of Technical Performance Measures (TPMs) throughout the design process
  • Contribute to System Design Reviews (SDR) and engineering governance structures such as Preliminary Design Reviews (PDR), Critical Design Reviews (CDR), Test Readiness Reviews (TRR), Safety Review Boards (SRB) representing the Systems Engineering discipline
  • Own and maintain Functional Decomposition, System Breakdown Structure (SBS), Product Breakdown Structure (PBS), and Architecture diagrams
  • Develop key Systems Engineering design artefacts including System Description Documents (SDDs) and Interface Control Documents (ICDs)
  • Champion the use of the Test and Evaluation Master Plan (TEMP) to enable Mission System and Payload maturation
  • Shape the design of representative Hardware In Lab (HIL) and Hardware In The Loop (HITL) physical integration environments, and input into surrogate testing
  • Create issue board workflows and coordinate ticket triage, action assignment, artefact capture and closure
  • Shape and coordinate configuration and change management processes
  • Support wholistic Systems Safety and Airworthiness efforts
  • Support build, ground and flight test of prototype and production representative Thunder Mission Systems with Physical Configuration Audits (PCA) and verification-related tasks

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • BEng/BSc/MEng in Aerospace, Mechanical, Electrical, Computer Science, Robotics, Mechatronics, or a similar engineering field, or equivalent experience
  • 8+ years industry Systems Engineering experience including safety-critical hardware and software systems in the Defence or Aerospace industries, specifically crewed aircraft, rotorcraft, EVTOL, UAS or weapon systems with a focus on Payload Integration, Vehicle Management Systems, GNC or Autonomy.
  • Demonstrable Systems Engineering proficiency, including solicitation of requirements with the customer/end-user, collaboration with design teams
  • Experience developing traditional and right-sized Systems Engineering artefacts, including pragmatic verification and validation plans
  • Deep understanding of the test and evaluation process as applicable to developmental, acceptance and operational testing
  • Experience with crewed or uncrewed developmental autonomous aircraft (Group 5 UAS or larger)
  • Proficiency in coordinating change management processes
  • Outstanding written and verbal communication skills to include presentation of developed artefacts
  • Eligible to obtain and maintain an active UKSV Security Clearance

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Experience with open mission system architectures, for example PYRAMID, OMS/UCI, or STANAG 4586, and with modular open systems approaches more generally
  • Experience with mission systems integration across multiple platforms, including abstraction layers or payload development kits intended for reuse
  • Experience with SysML v2, and with requirements management tooling such as Jama, including automated generation of specification and traceability artefacts
  • Working knowledge of UK export control and security regimes, including the UK Military List, SPIRE and OGELs, F680, and the handling of classified and OFFICIAL-SENSITIVE material
  • Exposure to guidelines, standards and processes such as ARP-4754, ARP-4761, DO-178C, DO-254 desirable
  • Experience with UK defence standards relevant to air systems and stores, for example Def Stan 00-970 and Def Stan 00-56
  • Experience transitioning technology out of development and into a delivery programme or product line
  • Familiarity with rigorous Systems Engineering approaches such as OOSEM
  • Familiarity with reliability engineering, safety analysis, and failure mode analysis
  • INCOSE Systems Engineering Professional certification

title: Senior Radio Frequency Engineer
description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

ABOUT THE TEAM

The Maneuver Dominance team is building Thunder - an autonomous attack rotorcraft built to fight alongside crewed combat aviation to deliver overwhelming mass effects deep beyond the front lines. The team in London builds the Mission System and the autonomy that makes aircraft like Thunder work.

Autonomy is only as good as the link that carries it. Thunder is a compact airframe with weapons, sensors and radios competing for the same antenna real estate, flying low and in formation, in a spectrum that is actively contested. That is the problem you would own.

ABOUT THE JOB

We are looking for an RF Systems Engineer to own the communications architecture for the Thunder Mission System. You will set the RF architecture and then go and prove it: developing link budgets and co-site analysis, running modelling and simulation, selecting and managing radio, antenna, and cabling vendor base, integrating hardware onto the platform, and troubleshooting it on the bench and in the field. You will be the authoritative voice for communications in vehicle-level trade studies, which means making calls that other disciplines will build around and being able to defend them.

We are looking for someone with low-ego and high-ownership, mission focused, meticulous about detail and as comfortable arguing a position as revising it when the measurements disagree. If you enjoy being the person a cross-functional team turns to when the RF problem is genuinely hard, this is that job.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

  • Architect, design, integrate, test, and optimise communications hardware across the Thunder Mission System and its subsystems.
  • Develop RF link budgets, co-site analysis, and desense reports, and translate them into design decisions the wider team can act on.
  • Configure, simulate, evaluate, and test RF systems and datalinks, in the lab and in the field.
  • Create and maintain RF system interconnect diagrams and supporting design documentation.
  • Select and manage radio, RF component, cable, and antenna vendors.
  • Represent the communications subsystem in vehicle-level, cross-disciplinary trade studies that define and optimise our platforms.
  • Support other engineering teams' development efforts by bringing an understanding of communications system impacts and trades to their design decisions.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • 7+ years of hands-on industry experience in RF systems design, build, test, and troubleshooting.
  • Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Depth in RF link budgets, co-site analysis, and desense, and a working understanding of EMI and the system-level integration issues that come with dense platforms.
  • Fluency with RF test equipment: spectrum analysers, network analysers, power meters, signal and function generators, and the judgement to know when a measurement is telling you something real.
  • Experience with RF system modelling and simulation.
  • Experience with the electrical integration of avionics modules and payloads into UAVs, ground vehicles, C2 systems, or weapons systems.
  • Working knowledge of aviation communications systems (radios, antennas, and similar) and tactical communications systems, plus the fundamentals of Ethernet and IP networking.
  • Python for test automation and data analysis, and a habit of automating any measurement you take more than twice.
  • The ability to work across disciplines: defining product requirements, running trade analyses, developing specifications, and conducting system-level tests with people who are not RF engineers.
  • Eligible to obtain and maintain an active UKSV Security Clearance.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Familiarity with Ofcom and/or FCC spectrum authorisations.
  • Familiarity with MIL-STD-461 and MIL-STD-464; DO-160 or MIL-STD-810 environmental qualification.
  • Experience with MANET and mesh waveforms (for example Silvus or DTC).
  • Experience designing or testing for GPS-denied and EW-contested environments.
  • Anechoic chamber and antenna pattern measurement experience.

Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

The Role

Anduril's Multi-National Digital Infrastructure (MDI) team builds and sustains the sovereign cloud, classified networks, edge compute, and coalition interoperability layer that Anduril's products depend on across nations and classification levels. The Principal Systems Engineer is MDI's chief engineer -- owning the technical vision, architectural coherence, and engineering standard for this infrastructure globally.

This is not a staff role that writes architecture docs and advises. You build. You ship. You set the standard by doing the work and then codifying the pattern so it scales without you in the room.

What You'll Do

Architectural Vision & Coherence

  • Engineering team operating at a higher standard -- evidenced by faster deployments, fewer rework cycles, stronger accreditation posture
  • Technical career path established for MDI engineers with clear growth trajectory

This role works in partnership with the MDI Lead. The MDI Lead owns what we build and why -- stakeholder relationships, program prioritization, BD pipeline, team growth strategy, and cross-division influence. The Principal Systems Engineer owns how it's built and how it scales -- architecture, engineering standards, technical feasibility, capability roadmap, hiring bar, and accreditation engineering.

  • Ability to commute to the London office regularly.

  • Experience selling to or working at start-ups, scaleups, or ISVs.

title: Senior Technical Architect (Privacy)
description:
Strength in Trust 

OneTrust’s mission is to enable innovation through the responsible use of data and AI. We believe that ensuring data is trusted shouldn’t slow teams down—it should accelerate what’s possible. This led us to develop the first technology platform for responsible data use in 2016. Today, with AI representing the latest and most impactful expansion of data yet, OneTrust is once again redefining what responsible innovation looks like. OneTrust, the AI‑Ready Governance Platform™, unifies regulatory intelligence, automation, and connected governance workflows so businesses can continue to move at the speed of AI while ensuring good governance to prevent data misuse at scale. Trusted by thousands of organizations worldwide, OneTrust is shaping the future where trusted data becomes a transformative force for business and society. 

The Challenge

We are looking for a Senior Technical Architect (Privacy) to join our Technical Advisory team (part of Customer Success). This is a customer-facing role for someone who combines a strong technical foundation with attention to details, and the ability to build trust with customers.

You will work with privacy, legal, compliance, and technology stakeholders to understand business objectives and challenges, assess maturity and platform adoption, and provide clear recommendations across privacy processes, operating models, workflows, data, and integrations. You will act as a trusted advisor and product expert without owning hands-on implementation or configuration.

Previous privacy or OneTrust expertise is valuable, but it is not the defining requirement for this role. We are looking for someone with the attitude, consultancy skills, and technical capability to learn the privacy domain quickly and become a trusted advisor.

Your Mission

  • Lead outcome-focused discovery, advisory engagements, workshops, and expert sessions with customers.
  • Clarify customer objectives, constraints, stakeholders, and desired outcomes before recommending a path forward.
  • Translate business and regulatory needs into practical recommendations for privacy processes, workflows, data, integrations, and OneTrust capabilities.
  • Explain solution options, dependencies, trade-offs, and implications for scale at the appropriate level of detail.
  • Assess customer readiness, adoption barriers, process maturity, and solution direction; recommend pragmatic next steps.
  • Create clear, decision-ready deliverables such as current-state assessments, future-state recommendations, reference architectures, process guidance, and reusable patterns.
  • Build trusted relationships and communicate confidently with both technical and executive audiences.
  • Partner closely with Customer Success, Product, Sales, Support, Professional Services, and other specialist teams to deliver consistent customer outcomes.
  • Capture recurring customer needs and translate them into feedback, enablement content, playbooks, and product opportunities.
  • Maintain clear advisory boundaries: provide strategic framing, product expertise, and guidance while enabling customers or delivery partners to execute implementation.

You Are 

Your Experience Includes:

  • 5+ years of experience in consulting, technical advisory, solution consulting, customer success, business analysis, transformation, or another customer-facing problem-solving role.
  • A strong technical background in enterprise software (ideally SaaS), systems, data, workflow design, integrations, APIs, solution architecture, or a related field.
  • A consultative approach: you listen carefully, ask effective questions, structure ambiguity, and turn complex problems into clear recommendations.
  • Strong learning agility and a constructive attitude, including curiosity, ownership, humility, resilience, and openness to feedback.
  • The ability to connect customer objectives to practical technology and operating-model decisions.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to adapt the message for executive, functional, and technical audiences.
  • Independent but also a team player
  • Experience influencing stakeholders and collaborating across functions without direct authority.
  • BA/BS in a related subject is required

Extra Impressive:

  • Experience in privacy, data protection, privacy operations, privacy technology, or a closely related field.
  • Experience with OneTrust Privacy Automation or comparable privacy-management platforms.
  • Familiarity with privacy regulations and frameworks
  • OneTrust certifications or relevant privacy credentials such as CIPP/E, CIPM, CIPT
  • Experience advising enterprise customers on adoption, optimization, governance, or value realization.
  • Experience creating reusable advisory playbooks, reference architectures, or enablement materials.
  • Experience in using software for reporting and task management, such as Salesforce

Where we Work

We are embracing an office-first culture, encouraging three days a week in office for most roles, with meaningful opportunities to collaborate and celebrate in person.

Each role may have specific requirements or flexibility depending on the scope of the position, so we encourage you to verify this with your recruiter during your first interview.

Benefits

As an employee at OneTrust, you will be part of the OneTeam. That means you’ll receive support physically, mentally, and emotionally so that you can do your best work both in and out of the office. This includes comprehensive healthcare coverage, flexible PTO, equity RSUs, annual performance bonus opportunities, retirement account support, 14+ weeks of paid parental leave, career development opportunities, company-paid privacy certification exam fees, and much more. Specific benefits differ by country. For more information, talk to your recruiter or visit onetrust.com/careers.

Resources  

Check out the following to learn more about OneTrust and its people: 

  • OneTrust Careers on YouTube
  • @LifeatOneTrust on Instagram

Your Data

You have the right to have your personal data updated or removed. You also have the right to have a copy of the information OneTrust holds about you. Further details about these rights are available on the website in our Privacy Overview. You can change your mind at any time and have your personal data removed from our database. In order to do this you must contact us and let us know you wish to be removed. The request should be made on the Data Subject Request Form.

 

Recruitment fraud warning: OneTrust is aware of scams involving false offers of employment with our company. The fraudulent jobs, interviews and job offers use fake websites, email addresses, group chat and text messages. Job offers will come from a recruiter and may have a ----- email address. For more information or if you have been targeted please reach out to .

Our Commitment to You 

When you join OneTrust you are stepping onto a launching pad — the countdown has begun. The destination? A career without boundaries working alongside a diverse and inclusive crew who is passionate about doing meaningful work. As a pioneer, your voice and expertise will help chart the direction of an entirely new category. Our commitment to putting people first starts with you. Your growth is part of the mission. Our goal is to give you the power to embark on the next phase of your uniquely, unique career.

title: GTM Engineer
description: About LILT AI is changing how the world communicates — and LILT is leading that transformation. We're on a mission to make the world's information accessible to everyone , regardless of the language they speak. We use cutting-edge AI, machine translation, and human-in-the-loop expertise to translate content faster, more accurately, and more cost-effectively without compromising on brand, voice, or quality. At LILT, we empower our teammates with leading tools, global collaboration, and growth opportunities to do their best work. Our company virtues— Work together, win together; Find a way or make one; Quicker than they expect; Quality is Job 1 —guide everything we do. We are trusted by Intel Corporation , Canva , the United States Department of Defense , the United States Air Force , ASICS , and hundreds of global Enterprises. Backed by Sequoia, Intel Capital, and Redpoint, we’re building a category-defining company in a $50B+ global translation market being redefined by AI. Go-To-Market at LILT Go-to-market at LILT is our strategic growth engine. Marketing, Sales Development, Sales, and Revenue Operations run together. We're responsible for telling LILT's story and what makes us different from other translation options in the market. We tell that story to the world with effective demand generation programs, and we turn it into revenue through the outbound and inbound motions our reps run every day. We're shaping how people understand LILT's brand, product, and the category we're building. We're expert storytellers and operators who work across the entire funnel, from awareness to conversion to expansion. We partner closely with Product and Customer Success to drive pipeline, accelerate adoption, and position LILT as the market leader in enterprise AI translation. This role has a cross-functional mandate by design. The systems that matter most right now sit on the Sales and RevOps side as much as the Marketing side: Account routing, the lead-to-opportunity process, ADR-facing tooling, signal scanning for the reps. You'll have explicit standing to audit, redesign, and rebuild AI workflows across all of our growth systems. We're building a world-class team and we're looking for ambitious, curious people who want to grow fast, work with seasoned operators, and help shape the future of AI and language. Whether it's crafting compelling narratives, launching new capabilities, running high-impact campaigns, or engineering the systems underneath all of it, we move fast, think big, and care deeply about quality. If you're excited about AI, language, and building a category-defining company, you'll thrive here. It's a place to work if you want to have a real impact, learn a ton, working hands-on building content, campaigns, programs, and systems you can be proud of. GTM Engineering at LILT As LILT scales, more of our go-to-market motion is powered by agentic AI, systems that can research, enrich, sequence, and act on our behalf, not just report on what already happened. This role sits at the center of that shift. You'll be the builder who turns "we should automate this" into a working, reliable system, owning the tools and automations that keep Marketing, Sales, and RevOps running smoothly. Examples of the kinds of systems that live in this role: AI-driven meeting and lead qualification agents that compile evidence from across our stack to make a judgment Account signal-scoring systems that combine data into a ranked, defensible view of where the team should spend its time AI-drafted outbound at scale , personalized from live account context These are illustrative rather than a fixed backlog. The specific builds will change; the shape of the work won't. Where You'll Work This role is based in our London office. We work in a hybrid model, with team members in the office 3 days per week to collaborate, brainstorm, and build together. You'll get the energy and creativity of in-person work, combined with the flexibility to focus from home when needed. What You'll Do This high-impact, hands-on role is responsible for owning LILT's agentic GTM systems: proposing, designing, building, and maintaining the AI-driven tools and automations that power our go-to-market engine, including our Clay-based enrichment and outbound workflows. You'll also play a critical role in optimizing our go-to-market technology stack, streamlining our lead-to-opportunity process, and helping to maintain day-to-day department operations. You'll work closely with GTM leadership across Sales Development, Sales, Marketing, and Operations and Systems functions to drive process optimization and overall efficiency. You'll recommend, build, and run cross-functional projects and process improvements that directly impact our operational efficiency and top-line growth of all revenue lines. You'll contribute to the strategy and execution of full-funnel programs that drive predictable, scalable pipeline. Key Responsibilities: Agentic business systems integration. Propose, design, build, and maintain agentic AI tools and automations that connect and orchestrate our GTM stack end-to-end, reducing manual work and increasing the speed and reliability of our lead-to-revenue motion. Own Clay and the automation stack. Serve as our resident expert on Clay (and similar enrichment/orchestration tools), building and maintaining tables, waterfalls, and workflows that keep our data accurate and our outbound motion running. Salesforce lead-to-opportunity. Partner closely with RevOps to own the workflow from a new lead entering the system, through the various lead stages, and converting to an opportunity, including routing, assignment, and the rules that decide who works what. Full-funnel ownership. Design and optimize the entire lead funnel, from top-of-funnel acquisition through MQL to SQL handoff, driving higher conversion and increased velocity. Lead and contact data integrity. Work with internal tools and external vendors to maintain a high quality database of contacts across our target industries and personas. Partner with Sales. Align tightly with revenue leadership to define pipeline goals, campaign targeting, SLAs, and lead management workflows. Sit close enough to the reps to know which parts of the process actually hurt. Fuel growth. Partner closely with the demand gen team to drive multi-channel campaigns across email marketing, webinars, paid media, SEO, events, outbound motions, and ABM to meet ambitious growth targets. Use data to scale. Build a data-driven culture. Forecast, measure, and communicate program results, continuously optimizing for ROI and CAC efficiency. Collaborate cross-functionally. Work across demand gen, product marketing, ADRs, and sales ops to build cohesive, conversion-optimized systems and campaigns. Department operations. Help with department-level planning for things like managing campaign budget, team meetings and activities, and annual planning. Documentation and knowledge continuity. Maintain living documentation (Notion) for every agent and workflow you own, to a standard where a new team member or another AI agent could pick up ownership without a live handover call. This is a stated expectation of the role, not an afterthought. Our Stack CRM and RevOps: Salesforce, Default Enrichment and orchestration: Clay, ZoomInfo Outbound and conversation intelligence: Amplemarket, Trellus Inbound and web conversion: Qualified Marketing automation: HubSpot Analytics: GA4, Salesforce reporting, Looker Studio Build environment: Python, LLM APIs, agentic coding tools, Notion for documentation Skills and Experience 3-5 years in B2B SaaS or AI/ML go-to-market engineering, RevOps, or marketing operations, with a track record of building automations that actually ship. Hands-on Clay expertise. You've built waterfall enrichment, scoring, and routing in Clay (or a comparable tool), and you can take a new use case from idea to live quickly. Agentic AI and automation fluency. Comfortable proposing, designing, and building agentic workflows and integrations using APIs, webhooks, and orchestration tools, to connect systems and eliminate manual work. Working proficiency in Python/other languages for building and maintaining AI agent pipelines. Comfortable working inside an existing codebase, not just writing standalone scripts. Comfortable reasoning about tradeoffs under cost and token constraints. You can explain not just what you built, but why you didn't build the more expensive or more complex version. Strong Salesforce fundamentals. You can build reports, understand the object model and the automation layer, and use what you find to change how the funnel actually performs. A point of view on where AI in GTM is heading. We'll ask. We're less interested in whether we agree than in whether you've thought about it seriously. Obsessed with the metrics that matter: MQLs, pipeline, bookings, funnel conversion, velocity, CAC, and ROI. Familiarity with marketing automation platforms (HubSpot or similar) a plus. Ability to build relationships and work cross-functionally. Smart, curious, and hard-working. Natural collaborator and communicator, comfortable presenting to executives, boards, and cross-functional stakeholders. Our Story Our founders, Spence and John met at Google working on Google Translate. As researchers at Stanford and Berkeley, they both worked on language technology to make information accessible to everyone. While together at Google, they were amazed to learn that Google Translate wasn’t used for enterprise products and services inside the company.The quality just wasn’t there. So they set out to build something better. LILT was born. LILT has been a machine learning company since its founding in 2015. At the time, machine translation didn’t meet the quality standard for enterprise translations, so LILT assembled a cutting-edge research team tasked with closing that gap. While meeting customer demand for translation services, LILT has prioritized investments in Large Language Models, human-in-the-loop systems, and now agentic AI. With AI innovation accelerating and enterprise demand growing, the next phase of LILT’s journey is just beginning. Our Tech What sets our platform apart: Brand-aware AI that learns your voice, tone, and terminology to ensure every translation is accurate and consistent Agentic AI workflows that automate the entire translation process from content ingestion to quality review to publishing 100+ native integrations with systems like Adobe Experience Manager, Webflow, Salesforce, GitHub, and Google Drive to simplify content translation Human-in-the-loop reviews via our global network of professional linguists, for high-impact content that requires expert review LILT in the News Featured in The Software Report’s Top 100 Software Companies! LILT makes it onto the Inc. 5000 List . LILT’s continues to be an intellectual powerhouse, holding numerous patents that help power the most efficient and sophisticated AI and language models in the industry. Check out all our news on our website . description: About The Role and Team Quantum Motion is a fast-growing quantum computing scale-up based in London founded by internationally renowned researchers from UCL and Oxford University with over 40 years’ experience in developing qubits and quantum computing architectures. Bringing together state-of-the-art cryogenic facilities and an outstanding interdisciplinary team, we are developing quantum processors based on industrial-grade silicon chips, with the potential to radically transform computing power in areas such as materials modelling, medicine, artificial intelligence and more. Our Team Since 2021 our team has been listed every year in the “Top 100 Startups worth watching” in the EE Times , and our technology breakthroughs have been featured in The Telegraph , BBC and the New Statesman . Our founders are internationally renowned researchers from UCL and Oxford University who have pioneered the development of qubits and quantum computing architectures. Our chairman is the co-founder of Cadence and Synopsys, the two leading companies in the area of Electronic Design Automation. We’re backed by a team of top-tier investors, and we have recently closed our Series C funding of $160 million. We bring together the brightest quantum engineers, integrated circuit (IC) engineers, quantum computing theoreticians and software engineers to create a unique, world-leading team, working together closely to maximise our combined expertise. Our collaborative and interdisciplinary culture is an ideal fit for anyone who thrives in a cutting-edge research and development environment focused on tackling big challenges and contributing to the development of scalable quantum computers based on silicon technology. Our team of 100+ is based in Oxford and London, with a centre of mass in our Islington lab. Functions of the Role As Director of Systems Delivery , you will build and lead the function responsible for the complete lifecycle of Quantum Motion’s full-stack silicon quantum systems, from initial programme planning, build, and integration through commissioning, acceptance testing, and handover. You will drive cross-functional alignment across hardware, software, systems integration, and operations. Key priorities include establishing delivery playbooks, acceptance protocols, and customer site infrastructure readiness, while synchronising complex silicon bring-up with agile software developments. We are seeking a pragmatic leader with proven experience managing multidisciplinary teams to deploy first-of-a-kind, deep-tech systems into field environments. Direct hardware experience in silicon, semiconductor, or advanced physical instrumentation is mandatory ; you must understand physical build constraints, microelectronics/systems integration, and environmental facility requirements. Full-Stack System Execution : Lead the Systems Delivery capability to execute internal full-stack system deployments, bridging physical hardware with full-stack software from assembly through customer handover. Cross-Functional Alignment : Coordinate across hardware, software, product, and operations teams to align physical hardware build schedules with software release cycles, managing dependency interfaces and trade-offs. Site Infrastructure Readiness : Oversee internal and customer site infrastructure preparation to ensure physical environments are ready for deployment. Acceptance Testing & Governance : Implement delivery schedules, risk management, and formal acceptance testing protocols. Service & Operational Handoff : Establish post-installation support frameworks, handovers, and field engineering processes to guarantee long-term operational uptime. Process Standardisation : Build scalable playbooks, quality standards, and repeatable processes for integration, validation, and operational readiness. Supply Chain Management : Manage technical hardware procurement, key vendor relationships, and supplier performance supporting delivery timelines. Commercial Scoping Support : Provide technical scoping, feasibility input, and operational planning for commercial proposals while fostering team accountability. Experience - Essentials Must have proven experience managing physical hardware systems (e.g., quantum, semiconductor, aerospace, or advanced scientific instrumentation) with a realistic understanding of physical build constraints and lead times. Demonstrated background managing hardware-software integration, physical systems validation, and site-installation constraints. Experience building, managing, and mentoring hardware, systems integration, or field delivery teams. Track record of taking first-of-a-kind physical hardware platforms from prototype to repeatable deployment models. Hands-on experience managing facility readiness and running structured customer acceptance protocols. Strong project management expertise tracking HW/SW critical paths, project budgets, risk registers, and executive reporting. Direct experience overseeing technical vendors, supplier selection, and component procurement. Strong communication skills with key stakeholders, including executive, technical, and customer audiences. Willingness and eligibility to travel internationally to customer sites as required. Experience - Desirable Direct technical background in quantum computing systems, cryogenic systems, silicon platforms, or HPC architectures. Experience establishing post-delivery field support, service handoffs, or customer support operations for complex hardware. Experience scaling system assembly and delivery operations within a deep-tech environment. Experience supporting hardware/software technical scoping for commercial proposals.   • Demonstrated leadership and ownership. Mentoring engineers, influencing technical direction, and being the person people depend on.

  • Designed systems that balance quick iterations with long-term reliability and maintainability.

  • Partnered with product, design, and non-technical stakeholders to define requirements, make tradeoffs, and deliver outcomes. Not just code.

Who You Are:

  • You care about the people on your team. Their growth, their output, and their experience.

  • You take ownership and seek autonomy over your work and outcomes.

  • You're excited to build and lead within a small, nimble, high-impact team.

  • You are self-directed. Comfortable prioritizing your own work and your team's with minimal oversight.

title: Director, Customer Support Network Strategy, Service Design & Workforce Management
description:
Wolt and Roo operate under the DoorDash umbrella, and Customer Support sits at the intersection of brand experience, unit economics and long-term growth. This role owns the strategy on:

  1. Where should we operate support, at what scale, and at what cost, across a rolling multi-year horizon?
  2. How do we architect frontline service design to be AI-ready as frontline tooling evolves, deliver best-in-class customer experience, and remain cost-efficient?
  3. How do we manage our workforce with precision, eliminating waste, consolidating overlapping structures, and continuously improving headcount efficiency through automation and org redesign?

This is a permanent leadership role. The person in this seat will own network strategy, service design and workforce management as a continuous discipline, embedding deeply into Wolt, Roo and DoorDash technology stacks, building and refreshing the financial and operational case for change, and evolving the execution roadmap as the business, technology and market shift.

Scope of Responsibility

A. Support Service Design

  • Own the demand and supply planning, and scheduling for the network, partnering deeply with upstream business owners and defect elimination to enable forecasting accuracy. 
  • Own ongoing assessment of how service is structured and delivered at the frontline across both brands.
  • Maintain the role architecture map: what roles exist, what they do, where they overlap.
  • Evaluate how tools (CRM, WFM, knowledge base, AI tools, ticketing) enable or constrain frontline roles, and keep this view current as tooling changes.
  • Own and evolve the target-state frontline model aligned to AI-augmented ways of working.
  • Continuously run gap analysis: current state vs. target state, with prioritised interventions.

B. Support Site Strategy

  • Own the support site footprint across both brands as an ongoing portfolio.
  • Maintain and refresh strategic site scenarios across cost, quality, risk and scalability as conditions change.
  • Own the financial model underpinning site strategy: OpEx, CapEx, transition cost, and planning cycles.
  • Continuously assess BPO vs. in-house mix, nearshore vs. offshore trade-offs, and consolidation opportunities.
  • Bring forward exec-ready recommendations as circumstances warrant, with clear pros, cons and decision criteria.
  • Keep the site strategy framed against contact volume reduction through automation.

C. Workforce Management Transformation

  • Own WFM maturity across both brands on an ongoing basis: demand forecasting, capacity planning, scheduling, real-time management.
  • Identify and close tooling gaps and duplication across Wolt and Roo WFM stacks.
  • Own and evolve the consolidated WFM target operating model.
  • Own the continuous efficiency case, driven through:
    • Org consolidation:  merging duplicated WFM roles across the two brands.
    • Contact automation: defect elimination and end-to-end customer-facing automation.
    • AI-assisted agent workflows: human-in-the-loop bot interfaces, AI-guided resolution, next-best-action tools.
    • Scheduling and real-time optimisation via AI/ML tooling.
  • Own tooling requirements and vendor strategy (shortlists, entries, exits) as an ongoing responsibility.

D. DoorDash Technology Integration

  • Maintain deep, current working knowledge of DoorDash's support technology stack.
  • Continuously translate technology capabilities into concrete business levers for the Wolt and Roo context.
  • Own the dependency map between integration milestones and the Support transformation roadmap.
  • Flag risks early where integration timelines could affect strategy execution.

E. Execution Planning

  • Own the rolling execution plan: prioritised initiatives, owners, investment, expected outcomes, refreshed as priorities shift.
  • Own the forward-looking roadmap: strategic bets, sequencing logic, capability-build requirements.
  • Own stakeholder alignment across Support Operations, Product, Finance and People functions on an ongoing basis.

Core Ongoing Responsibilities & Outcomes

  • Current state visibility: Maintain a living view of service design, site footprint, financial planning cycles and WFM maturity across Wolt & Roo, with an opinionated, forward-looking perspective on where the network needs to go.
  • DoorDash technology translation: Continuously map DoorDash technology capabilities to Wolt/Roo business levers, tracking upstream product, tooling and integration roadmaps and their implications for network design.
  • Support site strategy: Maintain a multi-year scenario model with full financial analysis, pros & cons, and a standing recommended path, developed in partnership with the wider Strategy and Operations organisation.
  • Planning mechanisms: Own and run weekly, monthly, quarterly and annual mechanisms for demand and supply planning (long and short term) and scheduling/real-time management, optimising for customer experience and efficiency, with clear visibility for executive leadership.
  • WFM transformation: Own the consolidated operating model, tooling spec, and the efficiency case for the organisation, with signed-off financial projections refreshed as the business evolves.
  • Roadmap ownership: Maintain a rolling forward roadmap covering strategic sequencing, capability investments, and automation maturity milestones, ratified through regular leadership review.
  • Stakeholder alignment: Keep all key workstream owners briefed, committed and clear on accountabilities on an ongoing basis.

All recommendations must be underpinned by a financial model, and must be decision-ready on first presentation.

Operating Rhythm

  • Embed & Orient (ongoing as scope evolves): Maintain stakeholder maps; stay immersed in Wolt, Roo & DoorDash systems; keep baseline data current; revisit scope and success criteria as the business changes.
  • Diagnose: Continuously reassess current state across all workstreams; keep DoorDash tech translation current; surface risks and quick wins as they emerge.
  • Design & Model: Maintain and evolve site strategy scenarios, the frontline service design blueprint, the WFM target model, and supporting financial models.
  • Synthesise & Align: Run regular executive forums and stakeholder sign-off cycles.
  • Roadmap & Continuity: Maintain the forward roadmap; ensure knowledge is embedded across the team rather than concentrated in one person.

Required Competencies

Competency

What Good Looks Like

Strategic clarity

Translates complexity into a small number of decisive choices. Never produces a report that fails to recommend.

Financial rigour

Builds robust P&L and scenario models independently. Understands how operational levers flow to unit economics.

CX & support operations depth

Credible across service design, contact centre strategy, WFM and automation.

AI & tooling fluency

Understands AI automation in a CX context: IVR/chatbot design, agent assist tools, LLM-powered workflows.

Speed to competence

Gets up to speed fast on unfamiliar technology stacks. Can read a product and understand business implications without hand-holding.

Stakeholder influence

Earns trust quickly at VP level and above. Drives alignment without authority. Comfortable challenging conventional thinking.

Structured communication

Writes concisely and presents with clarity.

Operator's mindset

Thinks in outcomes and owns them over time.

Experience Profile

Essential

  • 10+ years in customer support strategy, CX operations or contact centre consulting/leadership.
  • Demonstrable experience designing and executing site strategy at scale (multi-site, multi-brand, international).
  • Deep workforce management expertise: forecasting, capacity planning, scheduling, real-time management.
  • Experience leading or sponsoring automation programmes, contact reduction, chatbot, AI agent-assist.
  • Track record of delivering headcount efficiencies without degrading quality.
  • Strong financial modelling capability, built business cases independently.
  • Experience working inside or alongside a fast-growth tech company or marketplace.

Highly Desirable

  • Direct experience in food delivery, logistics or three-sided marketplace support.
  • Prior exposure to DoorDash, Wolt or comparable platforms.
  • Background delivering inside complex integrations or M&A contexts.
  • Familiarity with WFM platforms (e.g. Verint, AWS Connect, Assembled, Calibrio) and CX tooling (e.g. Zendesk, Intercom).

Ways of Working

  • This is a hands-on leadership role. 
  • The role requires deep, ongoing immersion in internal data, systems and teams.
  • All recommendations must arrive decision-ready.
  • The role operates with a high degree of autonomy, with regular visibility to leadership through written updates and reviews.
  • Escalation discipline: flag blockers fast. Never sit on a problem for more than 48 hours.
  • Intellectual honesty is non-negotiable.

title: Engineering Manager, Product Engineering
description: Who is Boulevard? Boulevard provides the first and only client experience platform for appointment-based, self-care businesses. We empower our customers to give their clients more of the magical moments that matter most. Before launching in 2016, our founders spent months interviewing salon managers and working behind front desks to understand their pain points so we could design a modern, user-friendly platform that meets the unique needs of their business. Our roots may be in hair salons, but we are built for the broader self-care industry, including many types of salons, spas, medspa, barbershops, and more. Our technology not only helps our customers survive but thrive. Take a look at how we (and YOU) can make that happen . We have an insatiable curiosity and embrace experimentation. We believe that simple solutions require the most sophistication, and we design each and every detail to maximize potential, power, and impact. Do our values match? Read through our story and what we value the most . Our team values and celebrates our diverse backgrounds. Being open about who we are and what we do allows us to do the best work of our lives. We believe in equal opportunity for all, and you should too. Come Do The Best Work Of Your Life At Boulevard As an Engineering Manager at Boulevard, you'll lead a team of talented engineers building the platform that powers thousands of self-care businesses. You'll balance technical leadership with people management, fostering a culture of excellence while delivering impactful products across a variety of domains. Our engineering teams are responsible for developing scalable, reliable, and user-centric solutions that help businesses grow and operate efficiently. Whether working on customer engagement, commerce, scheduling, or core platform capabilities, you’ll play a key role in shaping the future of our product and technology. What You'll Do Here: Lead and develop a team of 5-8 engineers across various experience levels. Conduct regular 1:1s, performance reviews, and career development planning. Partner with Product Management and Design to define and deliver the team roadmap. Drive technical excellence through code reviews and architectural guidance. Build a high-performing team culture focused on collaboration and growth. Manage team delivery, removing blockers, and ensuring successful execution. Contribute to hiring, interviewing, and onboarding new team members. Participate in on-call rotation and lead incident response when needed.
